_comment: Keyword anticipation calendar — events where search volume will spike. Publish content BEFORE the event so you're already ranked when demand arrives. This is how you beat competitors who only react to news.

ipos.description: Upcoming IPOs and direct listings. Publish valuation analysis 2-4 weeks before the expected date.
ipos.refreshTrigger: Any new filing, pricing, or date update

earnings.description: Quarterly earnings for major companies. Publish preview 1 week before, update with results same day.

fundingRounds.description: Anticipated funding rounds for hot startups. Publish valuation estimates before the round closes.

annualReports.description: Year-end and annual publications. Publish 'best of' and 'trends' content in December for January search volume.

regulations.description: Regulatory decisions, policy changes, legislation. Publish explainers before the decision date.

timing.refreshAfterEvent: 1 week post-event with actual results vs. predictions

contentStrategy: Start with a prediction/analysis piece before the event
Update the same URL on the event day (don't create a new page — you'll cannibalize yourself)
Refresh again 1 week later with actual results and what they mean
Each update triggers a lastmod signal that tells Google the page is current
Link to your prediction from your news wire / real-time content to build authority fast
